subject: Re: Request for updated subprocessor roster, evidence & cross-border mapping
messages:
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@fincent.com>

Cc: legal@fincent.com, compliance@fincent.com
Date: 2028-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Subprocessor roster + dataflow mapping request

Hi Olga,

We're preparing for our internal privacy review and need the most recent copy of Redwood's subprocessor roster and a simple dataflow diagram that shows where FinCent customer data transits (EU -> UK -> US, etc.). Specifically, can you confirm: 

- The current list of subprocessors and their primary processing locations
- Whether any subprocessors process unencrypted customer data in the US
- Whether cross-border transfers to the UK rely on SCCs + UK Addendum or a different legal basis
- Any recent subprocessor additions or planned changes in the next 30 days

If you have SOC 2 or KMS/HSM attestations for relevant vendors (KMS, logging, CDN), please include those or a pointer to a secure share. We need to provide evidence to procurement next week.

Appreciate a reply by Friday (Sep 1) if possible.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Lee
Head of Vendor Risk | FinCent Analytics
--
FinCent (external)
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-09-01T10:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Subprocessor roster + dataflow mapping request

Hi Sarah,

Thanks for the clear list — happy to help. Attaching our latest subprocessor roster (redwood_subprocessors_v2.csv) and a high-level EU/UK dataflow diagram (dataflow_eu_uk_diagram.pdf). Key points up front: 

- Attached roster contains primary processing countries and whether the processor handles encrypted or unencrypted data.
- No Redwood-managed subprocessors process unencrypted customer PII in the US by default; where partners require access for diagnostics, we use ephemeral, audited sessions and data is redacted.
- For UK transfers, we rely on the EU Standard Contractual Clauses plus the UK Addendum where the vendor is in scope; our legal team also maintains documented transfer mapping for each processor.
- Planned change: a CDN edge partner (EdgeRipple) will be added to the roster on 2028-09-20 for APAC caching (no access to backend message content; only cached static assets).

Quick summary table (inline):
- KMS: RedCrypt (EU primary, HSM-backed, attestations available)
- Logging: LogStream (EU/US, encrypted at rest, SOC2 Type II)
- CDN: EdgeRipple (APAC/US, caching only; planned addition 2028-09-20)
I'll share vendor attestations and SOC 2 links via secure share (see link below). If you need a signed subprocessor notice, we can produce that too.
Attachments:
- redwood_subprocessors_v2.csv (roster)
- dataflow_eu_uk_diagram.pdf (diagram)
Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cRedwood-Evidence-SecureShare
Let me know if you want a short call to walk through the diagram.
Best,
Olga Petrov
Manager, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Thanks Olga — this is helpful. A couple of follow-ups: 

1) For RedCrypt (KMS), can you confirm whether the HSM is customer-dedicated or multi-tenant? Procurement will want to know key separation.
2) For logging vendors that store logs in the US, do you have a retention range we can share?
3) For EdgeRipple, does the planned addition require any escalation of our DPA (i.e., will new subprocessors trigger an amendment)?

Also, can you provide SOC 2 Type II reports (or link) for RedCrypt and LogStream? If there are any vendor-specific data-processing addenda or SSC attestations, please include.

If easier, Rishi can drop the specific vendor evidence to our secure folder.

Best,
Sarah

Hi Sarah — forwarding the vendor evidence per Olga's note.

Attachments: kms_attest.pdf (RedCrypt HSM attestation)

Notes: 
- RedCrypt uses a multi-tenant HSM cluster but provides tenant key isolation via separate key rings and strict access controls; documented in kms_attest.pdf.
- LogStream SOC 2 Type II report is available; we uploaded it to the secure share.
- Retention: standard logging retention is 90 days for customer diagnostics; extended retention options are configurable per contract.
- EdgeRipple addition will be covered under our existing DPA; we will send a formal notification 14 days prior to activation and will only enable caching for non-sensitive assets unless you opt-in for deeper edge features.

Secure share (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cRedwood-Evidence-SecureShare
If you'd like a short technical sync with our infra/ops lead to walk through HSM separation and audit controls, I can schedule tomorrow.
Thanks,

Head of Infrastructure Operations
